::: {.course-section}
## Théorie de la décision et théorie des jeux

École nationale des ponts et chaussées · French

An introductory course on preferences and expected utility, risk aversion, dynamic choice, normal-form and extensive-form games, mixed strategies, and Nash equilibrium. The five original handouts have been cleaned up and consolidated into a single edition.

[Course description](theorie-decision-jeux.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
[Download the notes](/assets/teaching/theorie-decision-et-theorie-des-jeux.pdf){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

::: {.course-section}
## Introduction aux sciences économiques

École polytechnique · ECO361 · French

With Jean-Baptiste Michau and Vincent Rollet.

The textbook [*Introduction aux sciences économiques*](https://www.economica.fr/introduction-aux-sciences-economiques-c2x40926832) was published by Economica in 2024. Course notes are also available below.

[Download course notes](/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/ECO361-3.pdf){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
